note: Checkpoint examples for scene layout and occlusion verification. Each fixture documents a specific position/camera combination and the expected occlusion, shadow, and lighting output. These can be used by the coordinator to validate integration without running the full renderer.

counterOcclusion.description: Cel standing at count-pose behind counter

contactShadows.description: Contact shadows for cel standing at counter
contactShadows.note: Both feet planted on floor (y=1280, below counter clip y=1110), one hand resting on tray. Foot shadows render on Canvas layer below the SVG character. Hand shadow is at counter level, potentially visible.

contactShadows.description: Contact shadow during coinPlace at 53.95s contact
contactShadows.note: Coin has reached tray surface at 53.95s. Coin shadow is at full proximity (heightAbove=0). Expected shadow rx ~8, ry ~2.5.

contactShadows.description: Contact shadow during coinPlace at 53.75s (coin in arc)
contactShadows.note: Coin at lift apex y=1066, target tray y=1101. heightAbove=35, proximity=0.125. Shadow very faint and blurry on the tray surface.

contactShadows.description: Contact shadows during cue 2 walk (one foot planted, one swinging)
contactShadows.note: Left foot planted (weight=1), right foot in swing (weight=0, lifted from floor). The swinging foot produces no shadow. These shadows are on the open floor (x=530-560), NOT behind counter.

lightingGrade.note: Near the lamp (warm ~0.37), below cool glass spill zone, well within ambient radius (ambient ~0.53). Ambient slightly dominates warm due to broad radius. Faint void from doorway at ~167px.

Far from lamp (warm ~0), very close to ambient center (dist ~74px, ambient ~0.87), and close to rear door void (dist ~76px, void ~0.62). Void-shadow dominates visually despite high ambient because the darkening threshold is 0.3.

lightingGrade.description: Lighting near top of shop interior (500,650)
lightingGrade.note: In the cool glass spill zone. This position is above normal standing level but relevant for upper-body lighting when camera is high.
At rear door center (532,980). Strong void darkening (dist ~3px from door center, void ~0.60). Close to ambient center (dist ~100px, ambient ~0.82). This is where the cloth customer stands.

screenVisibility.description: Cel head visibility in work-drum shot start
screenVisibility.verdict: FULLY OFF-SCREEN. Cel head is 1154px beyond right edge.

screenVisibility.description: Cel head visibility in quiet shot end
screenVisibility.verdict: BARELY OFF-SCREEN RIGHT. 5px beyond right edge. Upper body may be partially visible if the character's shoulder extends left of head center.

screenVisibility.description: Cel right shoulder visibility in quiet shot end (shoulder at ~x660)
screenVisibility.verdict: BARELY VISIBLE. Right shoulder at screen x~1024 is inside the frame by 56px. This confirms task 2.1's concern: a shoulder or arm edge might show in quiet's final frames.
screenVisibility.note: Pose data for cue 5 quiet shot must ensure any visible shoulder/arm fragment looks continuous with the work shot.

screenVisibility.description: Cel head visibility in store shot (wide establishing)
screenVisibility.verdict: VISIBLE — small figure at counter. Screen center. Counter occlusion active.

screenVisibility.description: Coin-place hand visibility in decision shot at 53.75s
screenVisibility.verdict: VISIBLE — coin-hand position is well within frame during decision close-up.
screenVisibility.note: Camera interpolated at ~53.75s: cx=705+(-27)*ease(p), cy=1032+(-23)*ease(p), z=4.1+(-0.2)*ease(p) where p≈0.57 for frame ~1613 in decision shot [1576,1640)

screenVisibility.description: Cel at walk start (480,925) under nun shot camera
screenVisibility.verdict: VISIBLE at left edge. During cue 2 walk, if cel starts at x=480 under the nun camera, the head is at screen x~87 — left side of frame but visible. This confirms the walk path is filmable under the nun camera.
screenVisibility.note: The nun shot serves cue 2. If cel walks from x=480 to x=690, the head moves from screen x~87 to x~601 — a satisfying left-to-right walk across the frame.

drawOrder.description: Draw order when cel is behind counter
drawOrder.note: Counter body drawn in front of cel's lower body. Only above-counter portion visible.

drawOrder.description: Draw order when cel is on open floor (walking)
drawOrder.note: Full body visible. Counter draws behind cel. This is the full-body walking case that requires CR-04/CR-05 resolution.
